510	## Performance Rules (Non-Negotiable)
511	
512	### Strict Budgets:
513	- **LCP:** < 2.5s (identify LCP element per page, preload critical assets)
514	- **CLS:** < 0.1 (reserve space for images, fonts, dynamic content)
515	- **FID:** < 100ms (minimize main-thread JS in above-fold)
516	- **Total JS bundle:** < 200KB for public pages (use dynamic imports for below-fold)
517	- **Images:** Always lazy-load below-fold, WebP format, srcset for responsive
518	
519	### Progressive Enhancement:
520	- Core content readable without JS (SSR/SSG via Next.js)
521	- Animations enhance but never gate content
522	- Interactive elements have static fallback states
523	- Fonts load with `font-display: swap` -- no invisible text
524	
525	### Performance-Aware Design Choices:
526	- CSS animations over JS animations when possible
527	- `will-change` or `contain: paint` on animated elements
528	- Font subsetting for large character sets
529	- SVG icons inline for critical UI, sprite for below-fold
530	- Background gradients as CSS, never as images
531	- `backdrop-blur` limited to 5 elements per page (GPU-intensive)
532	- `prefers-reduced-motion`: remove all transform-based animations, keep opacity

536	## Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA -- Non-Negotiable)
537	
538	Every spec must include:
539	- **Contrast ratios:** All text/background combos noted, minimum 4.5:1 text / 3:1 UI
540	- **Focus order:** Logical tab sequence specified per section
541	- **ARIA requirements:** Landmarks, live regions, button labels, image alt text direction
542	- **Keyboard navigation:** All interactive elements keyboard-accessible
543	- **Touch targets:** Minimum 44x44px on mobile
544	- **Screen reader:** Semantic HTML structure (nav, main, section, article, aside, footer)
545	- **Motion:** All animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`
546	- **Color independence:** Information never conveyed by color alone

396	- **Info card:** `Card` with `CardHeader` (title + description) + `CardContent`

402	- **Primary action:** `variant="default"` (filled). One per view.

424	### Design Error Taxonomy (extends universal)
425	
426	| Error Class | Detection | Auto-Fix Strategy |
427	|---|---|---|
428	| **Contrast fail** | WCAG AA ratio < 4.5:1 for text, < 3:1 for large text | Darken/lighten the weaker color by 10% increments until passing. Never change brand primary — adjust background instead |
429	| **Spacing inconsistent** | Adjacent elements use different spacing values not on the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64 scale | Snap to nearest value on the scale. When in doubt, go larger (more breathing room) |
430	| **Breakpoint overflow** | Content overflows container below md (768px) | Stack horizontally-laid elements vertically. Reduce padding by 1 step. Hide non-essential elements with `hidden md:block` |
431	| **Component mismatch** | Wrong component for the UX pattern | Dialog → only for destructive confirmations. Sheet → for forms/detail views. Popover → for quick actions. Drawer → for mobile nav |
432	| **Dark mode broken** | HSL values hardcoded instead of using CSS variables | Replace all hardcoded colors with `hsl(var(--xxx))` variables. Test both modes after fix |
433	| **Visual hierarchy flat** | All text same size/weight, no clear scanning path | Apply size scale: heading 2xl+bold, subheading lg+semibold, body base+normal, caption sm+muted |
434	| **Touch target too small** | Interactive element < 44x44px | Add padding to reach 44px minimum. For icon buttons, use `h-11 w-11` minimum |
435	
436	### Self-Fix vs Escalate Decision
437	
438	Vega fixes these DIRECTLY (no Koda needed):
439	- Spacing adjustments (padding, margin, gap)
440	- Color/contrast corrections using CSS variables
441	- Font size/weight hierarchy
442	- Component prop changes (variant, size)
443	- Responsive class additions (sm:, md:, lg: prefixes)
444	- Dark mode variable corrections
445	- Accessibility attributes (aria-label, role, tabindex)
446	
447	Vega ESCALATES to Koda:
448	- Component replacement (Dialog → Sheet requires code restructure)
449	- Layout architecture changes (grid → flex, sidebar → tab navigation)
450	- Animation/transition additions requiring JS state
451	- Data fetching changes affecting what's displayed
452	- New component creation (not in shadcn/ui)
453	
454	### Vega Completion Proof (Numeric Thresholds)
455	
456	Before declaring ANY design work done, verify ALL:
457	
458	| Check | Threshold | How to Verify |
459	|---|---|---|
460	| Color contrast | >= 4.5:1 all text, >= 3:1 large text | Check with WebAIM contrast checker |
461	| Touch targets | >= 44x44px all interactive elements | Measure in dev tools |
462	| Spacing consistency | 100% values from 4px scale | Grep for arbitrary values not on scale |
463	| Responsive | No overflow at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1280px | Test all 4 breakpoints |
464	| Dark mode | All colors use CSS variables, both modes tested | Toggle theme, visual check |
465	| Visual hierarchy | Clear 3-level type scale minimum | Squint test — can you scan in 3 seconds? |
466	| Empty states | Every data-dependent view has empty state designed | Check all lists, tables, cards |
467	| Loading states | Every async view has skeleton/spinner | Check all data-fetching components |
468	| Error states | Every form/action has error display | Trigger errors intentionally |

475	## Vega Edge Case Decision Tree
476	
477	When encountering these situations, Vega decides autonomously:
478	
479	### 1. Long Text Overflow
480	- **< 50 chars:** Display fully
481	- **50-120 chars:** Allow wrapping, ensure container grows
482	- **120+ chars:** Truncate with `line-clamp-2` + tooltip showing full text on hover
483	- **User names:** Max 30 chars, truncate with ellipsis
484	- **Descriptions:** Max 3 lines, truncate with "Show more" expand
485	
486	### 2. Responsive Layout Decisions
487	- **1 column content:** Stack top-to-bottom at all sizes
488	- **2 column (sidebar + content):** Side-by-side at lg+, stacked at md and below. Sidebar becomes top sheet on mobile
489	- **3+ columns:** Grid at xl, 2-col at lg, stacked at md and below
490	- **Tables:** Horizontal scroll on mobile (never stack table rows into cards unless explicitly asked)
491	- **Navigation:** Top nav at lg+, hamburger menu at md and below
492	
493	### 3. Empty/Zero States
494	- **List with 0 items:** Show illustration + title + description + primary CTA. Never show empty table/list frame
495	- **Dashboard with no data:** Show onboarding wizard or setup checklist, not empty charts
496	- **Search with 0 results:** Show search term + suggestion to broaden + clear filters CTA
497	- **Error loading data:** Show retry button + brief error explanation. Never show raw error messages
498	
499	### 4. Dark Mode Decisions
500	- **Brand colors:** Keep primary/accent the same, adjust background and surface colors only
501	- **Shadows:** Replace with subtle borders in dark mode (shadows are invisible on dark)
502	- **Images:** Add subtle border or rounded corner, don't invert
503	- **Charts:** Use lighter stroke colors, ensure data points visible against dark background
504	- **Text:** Primary text `hsl(var(--foreground))`, muted text `hsl(var(--muted-foreground))`. Never hardcode white/black
505	
506	### 5. Component Selection Matrix
507	
508	| Need | Component | NOT This |
509	|---|---|---|
510	| Confirm destructive action | AlertDialog | Dialog |
511	| Edit form in context | Sheet (from right) | Dialog (blocks view) |
512	| Quick action (3-5 options) | DropdownMenu | Dialog, Popover |
513	| Multi-step form | Multi-step inside Sheet | Separate pages |
514	| Status/notification | Toast (sonner) | Alert, Dialog |
515	| Filter/sort options | Popover with form | Dialog, Sheet |
516	| Navigation (mobile) | Sheet (from left) | Dialog |
517	| Data display (5+ fields) | Card with sections | Single flat div |
518	| Selection from long list | Combobox (Command) | Select (if > 10 items) |

359	
360	**Core voice:** Confident, clear, and conversion-focused.

362	**The 5 Rules:**
363	1. **Outcomes, not features** — "Rank 100 resumes in 60 seconds" not "AI-powered resume analysis engine"
364	2. **Plain language** — Write at grade 8 level. If a 14-year-old can't understand it, simplify
365	3. **Remove doubt** — Answer objections before they're asked. "No credit card required" next to signup
366	4. **Specific numbers** — "Save 10 hours/week" not "save time". "95% accuracy" not "highly accurate"
367	5. **Move to action** — Every piece of copy should make the reader want to DO something. End with CTA
